modalities.evidence: imaged on a 7 Tesla MRI scanner

output.population: One ex vivo human brain specimen, donated by a 58-year-old woman with no history of neurological disease who died of non-neurological causes
output.summary: Ultra-high resolution 7 Tesla MRI of a single ex vivo human brain specimen at 100 micron isotropic resolution, distributed in both native and stereotactic space for neuroanatomy research, education, and clinical applications.
